per_sentence.sent_id: oilrig_Please Confirm You Received Our APT _ FortiGuard Labs _p1_s1
per_sentence.text: It began with a spearphishing email to a diplomat in Jordan.

per_sentence.sent_id: oilrig_Please Confirm You Received Our APT _ FortiGuard Labs _p1_s2
per_sentence.text: Like many of these attacks, the email contained a malicious attachment.

per_sentence.sent_id: oilrig_Please Confirm You Received Our APT _ FortiGuard Labs _p1_s3

per_sentence.sent_id: oilrig_Please Confirm You Received Our APT _ FortiGuard Labs _p1_s4
per_sentence.text: Instead, it had the capabilities and techniques usually associated with advanced persistent threats (APTs).

per_sentence.sent_id: oilrig_Please Confirm You Received Our APT _ FortiGuard Labs _p1_s5
